aboutBnbm.title: About {beloved}
aboutBnbm.intro: Beloved New Beginning Ministries (BNBM) is a Spirit-filled, Christ-centered ministry dedicated to spreading the gospel of Jesus Christ and transforming lives through the power of God's Word.
aboutBnbm.leadership: Founded under the prophetic leadership of {prophetess}, our ministry is a beacon of hope, healing, and restoration for believers seeking to walk in their divine purpose and experience God's supernatural breakthrough.
aboutBnbm.commitment: We are committed to raising a generation of believers who walk in {royalGrace}, equipped with the knowledge of God's Word and empowered by the Holy Spirit to fulfill their God-given destiny.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be a beacon of God's love, spreading the gospel of Jesus Christ to all nations, and raising a generation of believers who walk in righteousness, power, and divine purpose. We envision a church where every member is equipped to fulfill their God-given destiny.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To worship God in spirit and in truth, disciple believers to spiritual maturity, empower them with the Word of God, and reach the lost through evangelism, outreach, and compassionate service.

coreValues.title: Our Core Values
coreValues.subtitle: The foundation of everything we do
coreValues.faithDesc: We believe in the power of unwavering faith in Jesus Christ
coreValues.prayerDesc: We are a house of prayer, interceding for our community and the world
coreValues.wordDesc: We uphold the Bible as the inspired, infallible Word of God
coreValues.holinessDesc: We pursue righteous living and spiritual purity in all we do
coreValues.loveDesc: We demonstrate God's unconditional love to all people
coreValues.serviceDesc: We serve God and our community with humility and excellence

leadership.title: Our Leadership
leadership.subtitle: Meet the team shepherding our church
leadership.founderBio: Called by God to establish Beloved New Beginning Ministries, Prophetess Toyin Jato is a vessel of God's power and grace. With a heart for the lost and broken, she ministers in prophetic insight, healing, and deliverance. Her passion is to see believers walk in their God-given authority and fulfill their divine purpose.

whatWeBelieve.title: What We Believe
whatWeBelieve.subtitle: Our statement of faith
whatWeBelieve.trinityDesc: We believe in one God existing in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
whatWeBelieve.salvationDesc: We believe salvation is by grace through faith in Jesus Christ alone.
whatWeBelieve.bibleDesc: We believe the Bible is the inspired, infallible Word of God.
whatWeBelieve.churchDesc: We believe the church is the body of Christ, called to make disciples.
whatWeBelieve.returnDesc: We believe in the personal return of Jesus Christ and eternal life.

joinUs.title: Join Our Community
joinUs.description: We invite you to be part of our growing family. Experience the love of God and walk in your divine purpose.

prophetess.title: Prophetess <styled>Toyin Jato</styled>
prophetess.paragraph1: Prophetess Toyin Jato is a woman of God with a powerful prophetic calling and an unwavering passion for souls. She is the founder and Senior Prophetess of Beloved New Beginning Ministries.
prophetess.paragraph2: With a heart ablaze for God's presence and a deep burden for the lost, she operates in the prophetic with remarkable accuracy, bringing forth timely words of direction, comfort, and breakthrough to believers across nations.
prophetess.paragraph3: Her ministry is characterized by powerful worship, supernatural healings, deliverance from demonic oppression, and life-changing testimonies. Through her leadership, countless individuals have experienced divine restoration, financial breakthroughs, marital restoration, and freedom from generational curses.
prophetess.paragraph4: Prophetess Toyin also founded <tdgi>TDGI Enterprise</tdgi> and <foundation>Toyin Jato Foundation International</foundation>, extending her ministry's impact through faith-based products and humanitarian outreach programs.
prophetess.quote: "I am called to raise a generation that walks in Royal Grace and Purity, empowered by the Holy Spirit to fulfill their divine destiny."

questions.question: What should I expect on my first visit?
questions.answer: You can expect a warm welcome, uplifting worship, and practical biblical teaching. Come as you are – there's no dress code! Our service lasts about 90 minutes.

questions.question: Do you have programs for children?
questions.answer: Yes! We have age-appropriate programs for children from nursery through high school during our Sunday services. All our children's workers are background-checked and trained.

questions.question: Is parking available?
questions.answer: We have ample free parking on-site. Our parking team will help direct you to available spots when you arrive.

questions.question: How can I get involved?
questions.answer: There are many ways to serve! Contact us to learn about volunteer opportunities in worship, hospitality, children's ministry, and community outreach.
